unit_attributes.statement: The purpose of 8 FAM 801.2 is to provide guidance regarding the use of information request letters (IRLs) and information notices (INs).

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Identifies the definition of information request letters (IRLs) in 8 FAM 801.2-1(b).
unit_attributes.statement: Information request letters (IRLs) are personalized, standardized letters with a date and signature block that request from the applicant additional information, documentation, or action needed to process the passport application.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Identifies the adjudicator's duty before suspending an application in 8 FAM 801.2-1(b).
unit_attributes.statement: You must fully adjudicate the application prior to suspending to ensure that you are addressing all issues.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Descriptive background regarding the design of IRLs in 8 FAM 801.2-1(b).
unit_attributes.statement: The IRLs have been carefully crafted to communicate clearly and accurately statutory, regulatory, and other requirements of the Department.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Governs passport agencies/centers regarding alterations to IRLs under 8 FAM 801.2-1(b)(1), including approval requirements and the extenuating circumstances exception.
unit_attributes.statement: Passport agencies/centers must not make unilateral changes or alterations to the IRLs without the approval of the Office of Adjudication (CA/PPT/S/A), except on a case-by-case basis with the approval of passport agency/center management in extenuating circumstances (e.g., when you request that the applicant submit a birth certificate instead of a notification of birth registration, and the applicant insists that the notification of birth registration is the birth certificate).

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Specifies the baseline duty for posts using IRLs under 8 FAM 801.2-1(b)(2).
unit_attributes.statement: Posts must use the cleared language in the IRLs.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Specifies authority granted to posts to modify IRL language under 8 FAM 801.2-1(b)(2).
unit_attributes.statement: Posts are authorized to modify the language in the IRLs to suit local logistical requirements and other local concerns such as available documentation.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Clarifies the non-adjudicative status of IRLs in the Note following 8 FAM 801.2-1(b)(2).
Sets forth the requirement for adjudicating passport applications and selecting IRLs in the Note to 8 FAM 801.2-1(b)(2).
unit_attributes.statement: The passport application must be adjudicated in accordance with 8 FAM and then the appropriate IRL selected to address any deficiencies with the passport or Consular Report of Birth Abroad (CRBA).

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Provides the definition and general purpose of information notices (INs) under 8 FAM 801.2-1(c).
unit_attributes.statement: Information notices (INs) are standardized notices that provide passport bearers with information about their passports.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Describes illustrative examples of IN inclusion under 8 FAM 801.2-1(c).
unit_attributes.statement: An IN may be included to explain why the passport was limited in validity, and/or what documentation is needed to obtain a fully valid passport.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Explains the design purpose of INs under 8 FAM 801.2-1(c).
unit_attributes.statement: The INs have been carefully crafted to communicate this information clearly and accurately.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Prohibits unilateral changes to INs at passport agencies/centers, including the extenuating circumstances exception under 8 FAM 801.2-1(c).
unit_attributes.statement: No changes or alterations to the INs may be made unilaterally at passport agencies/centers without the approval of CA/PPT/S/A, except in extenuating circumstances on a case-by-case basis with the approval of passport agency/center management (e.g., when using an endorsement 46 to limit a passport for a special problem).
unit_attributes.modality_quote: no changes or alterations to the INs may be made

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Specifies that INs do not require applicant response under 8 FAM 801.2-1(c).
unit_attributes.statement: INs do not require a response from the applicant.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Specifies that INs do not require personalization under 8 FAM 801.2-1(c).
unit_attributes.statement: INs do not need to be personalized with the applicant's name and address.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Identifies options available to posts when tailoring correspondence under 8 FAM 801.2-1(d).
unit_attributes.statement: When tailoring correspondence to a situation, posts may consult Passport Services’ IRL index and IN Index or contact AskPPTAdjudication@state.gov.
